KAVACH 4.0 Voice Assistant
Version %1$s

A bilingual (English/Hindi) voice and text reference tool covering KAVACH 4.0 subsystems, startup procedure, operating modes, SOS handling, collision scenarios, and safety rules for loco pilots.

Training aid, not the authority. Always follow your zonal railway's G&SR, the official KAVACH user manual, and current OEM instructions.
